title: Pubnet InvokeHostFunction that auto-restores an archived contract code entry (LEDGER_ENTRY_RESTORED)
why: Since Protocol 23 an invocation whose footprint marks an archived entry for restore brings it back in the same operation, and the meta reports it as LEDGER_ENTRY_RESTORED. Here the archived entry is the contract's Wasm, a CONTRACT_CODE entry, restored with its TTL among ordinary state/updated changes; readers that only expect contract data to be restored, or that do not know the restored change type, drop the code entry.
notes: Chosen with the locate index of the full pubnet scan (token `D|chg|op:INVOKE_HOST_FUNCTION#chg:RESTORED:CONTRACT_CODEx1`): among the ledgers that hold the shape, the one with the smallest lake object. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture. `expect.values` are written by hand from the decoded sidecar; participants, state changes and movements are the reference extractor's output, checked against the sidecar.

values.note: The restored CONTRACT_CODE entry (code with cost inputs, ext v1).
Its TTL entry is restored with it.
An ordinary call; the restore is a side effect of the footprint.
